name: prisma-learn
description: Beginner-to-advanced Prisma 7 learning project on a local throwaway PostgreSQL database

scripts.db:migrate: npm run db:check && prisma migrate dev
scripts.db:deploy: npm run db:check && prisma migrate deploy
scripts.db:status: npm run db:check && prisma migrate status
scripts.db:push: npm run db:check && prisma db push
scripts.db:seed: npm run db:check && prisma db seed
